records.name: Open Philanthropy Founding Grant
records.notes: Founding grant from Open Philanthropy (recommended to Good Ventures) for CHAI's establishment at UC Berkeley. Amount $5,555,550 over five years. Confirmed via vipulnaik.com donations database and Open Philanthropy grant page as of 2026-06-07.

records.name: Open Philanthropy Multi-Year Renewal
records.notes: Multi-year renewal grant from Open Philanthropy to CHAI, described as funding to 'expand research and student training'. Amount $11,355,246. Confirmed via vipulnaik.com donations database as of 2026-06-07.
